models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts for unauthenticated visitors identified by device email address.

This actor table represents users who have registered with a guest account but have not yet upgraded to full member status. Guest accounts allow temporary access to the todo application with standard authentication capabilities including email/password login, password change, and account deletion.

**Relationships**:
- One-to-many sessions: Each guest may have multiple {@link todo_app_guest_sessions} records for different login sessions
- Account lifecycle: Guests can upgrade to member status by completing registration or can delete their account entirely

**Business Rules**:
- Each guest account is identified by a unique email address (case-insensitive)
- Guest accounts support full authentication: login, password change, account deletion
- Soft delete enabled for cleanup of inactive guest accounts
- All authentication credentials are hashed for security compliance

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for guest account authentication. Case-insensitive for login validation. Must be unique across all guest accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for guest account authentication. Stored securely with appropriate cost factor.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated (includes password changes, email updates).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft-deleted. Null indicates active account.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access with device-based identification.

This table tracks login sessions for unauthenticated guest visitors in the todo application. Each session represents a temporary authenticated state associated with a guest account identified by device characteristics.

Sessions are managed through authentication flows rather than direct user CRUD operations. They serve as an append-only audit trail of login events, storing connection metadata including IP address, request context, and expiration timestamps for security purposes.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_guests} - The parent guest account this session belongs to

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the request.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL from the incoming request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the request headers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email/password credentials for authentication.

This table represents the primary identity record for authenticated members in the private todo application. Each member account has a unique email address used for login and authentication, with a securely hashed password stored for credential verification.

Members can manage their private todos, view edit history, and maintain profile information including a display name. This actor table serves as the foundation for all member-specific operations and authentication flows.

Related tables:
- {@link todo_app_member_sessions} - Stores JWT session tokens for member authentication
- {@link todo_app_member_password_resets} - Contains password reset tokens for account recovery
- {@link todo_app_member_email_verifications} - Manages email verification tokens for registration

Each member owns a set of private todos that are completely isolated from other members' data.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for member authentication and login. Stored in lowercase for case-insensitive comparison. Required for account creation and must be unique across all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plain text. Updated when member changes their password.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public-facing display name shown in the todo application. Used for identifying the member in UI and audit trails. Members can update their display name.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created. Immutable creation time for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the member account. Automatically updated on any modification to email, password_hash, or display_name.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted. Null indicates active account. When non-null, the account is marked for permanent deletion and all associated todos will be purged.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

Tracks login sessions for registered members, storing connection metadata and temporal fields for session lifecycle management. Each session represents a distinct authentication event with full audit trail for security and compliance.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link todo_app_members} - one member can have multiple concurrent sessions (multi-device access)
- Session is managed through member authentication flows, not direct user CRUD

Session lifecycle:
- Sessions are created automatically upon successful member login
- Sessions expire based on configured token policy (access tokens typically short-lived, refresh tokens longer-lived)
- Session records remain in the database as an audit trail of login events

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link todo_app_members.id}. Reference to the authenticated member account that created this session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the login request. Used for session security and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL from the login request. Captures the page or endpoint where authentication occurred.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header from the login request. Helps track user journey and authentication source.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp. Records when the member successfully authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. When the session token expires and becomes invalid. Critical for security - sessions must have defined expiration.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery.

This table stores temporary reset tokens that allow members to securely reset their passwords after losing access to their current credentials. Each password reset request creates a new entry with a unique token and expiration timestamp.

The token is invalidated after successful password reset or expiration, ensuring only one active reset token per request. Members can request multiple password resets, creating separate entries in this table, though typically only one valid token should exist per active reset request.

Related entities:
- {@link todo_app_members} - Member accounts that can request password resets
- {@link todo_app_member_sessions} - Similar session-based temporary token storage

This is an authentication support table with session stance, meaning it is managed through the password reset authentication flow rather than direct user CRUD operations. Entries are created when a member requests a password reset and are automatically invalidated after use or expiration.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account's {@link todo_app_members.id} that requested the password reset. This relationship is mandatory as every password reset token must be associated with a member account.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token. This is a cryptographically secure random string that must be unique across all active reset tokens. The token is used in password reset URLs and is validated against the database entry.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. After this time, the reset token becomes invalid and cannot be used to reset the password. Tokens typically expire within a short window (e.g., 1-24 hours) for security reasons.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. When the password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. For auditing and tracking token usage.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for cleanup. Used to track when tokens should be permanently removed from the database after expiration or successful use.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for member registration validation.

This table stores temporary verification tokens generated when a new member account is created. Each token is tied to a member account and expires after a set time period. Tokens are consumed when the member verifies their email address, after which they are marked as used and cannot be reused.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link todo_app_members} actor account
- Tokens are automatically created during member registration
- Tokens are automatically consumed during email verification

Behavioral notes:
- Each token can only be used once
- Expired tokens are considered invalid
- Cleanup queries may remove old unused tokens

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account's {@link todo_app_members.id} that owns this verification token.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string. Generated during registration, used during email verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Tokens after this time are invalid.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Whether this verification token has been consumed. Once used, the token cannot be reused.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used. Null if the token has not yet been used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for cleanup purposes. Null if the record is active.

models.description:
Main todo entity storing task title, description, dates, completion status, and soft delete flag with user reference.

This table represents individual todo items in the private todo application. Each todo is owned by a single member user and can be viewed, edited, completed, and deleted (soft delete to trash) by its owner only.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to a {@link todo_app_members} via member_id (1:N from user perspective)
- Has many {@link todo_app_edit_histories} entries when edited

Behavioral notes:
- Soft delete pattern: is_deleted flag marks deleted todos, which are moved to trash
- Deleted todos have deleted_at timestamp set, others remain null
- is_deleted todos don't appear in normal todo list, only in trash view
- New todos are incomplete (is_complete: false) by default
- Only the todo owner can view, edit, or delete their todos (privacy isolation)

foreignFields.description: Owner member's {@link todo_app_members.id}. Each todo belongs to exactly one member user.
foreignFields.name: member_id

models.name: todo_app_todos

plainFields.description: Task title. Required field, cannot be empty or whitespace.
plainFields.name: title

plainFields.description: Task description. Optional field that can be left empty.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Planned start date for the task. Optional, can be left empty.
plainFields.name: start_date

plainFields.description: Deadline date for the task. Optional, can be left empty.
plainFields.name: due_date

plainFields.description: Completion status. false = incomplete (default for new todos), true = complete. Simple toggle between two states.
plainFields.name: is_complete

plainFields.description: Soft delete flag. false = active todo (visible in normal list), true = deleted todo (moved to trash). Defaults to false for new todos.
plainFields.name: is_deleted

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo was last modified.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo was soft deleted (moved to trash). Null if not deleted.
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: todo_app_edit_histories
models.description:
Edit history tracking every todo modification with previous and new values for all fields plus audit timestamp.

This is a subsidiary table that is automatically created when a todo is edited. Each entry records:
- When the edit was made (created_at)
- Which member made the edit (todo_app_member_id)
- What the previous values were for each field
- What the new values are for each field

Users can view the full edit history of any of their todos to see the complete audit trail of changes. History entries are immutable once created and are automatically deleted when their parent todo is permanently deleted.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todos_id
foreignFields.description: Todo's {@link todo_app_todos.id} that this edit history entry belongs to.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link todo_app_members.id} who made this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this edit was made.

plainFields.name: previous_title
plainFields.description: Title value before this edit (if title was changed).

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: Title value after this edit (if title was changed).

plainFields.name: previous_description
plainFields.description: Description value before this edit (if description was changed).

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: Description value after this edit (if description was changed).

plainFields.name: previous_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date value before this edit (if start date was changed).

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date value after this edit (if start date was changed).

plainFields.name: previous_due_date
plainFields.description: Due date value before this edit (if due date was changed).

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: Due date value after this edit (if due date was changed).

models.name: todo_app_user_profiles
models.description:
User profile metadata table storing display name and validation timestamps for business rule enforcement.

This subsidiary table extends the member actor identity with profile-specific information required for the todo application's business logic. Each registered member (todo_app_member) has exactly one profile record that stores their public display name and tracks when it was last modified to enforce rate limiting policies (maximum one change per day).

The profile is a 1:1 relationship with todo_app_members - the FK has a unique constraint to ensure one profile per member. Display names are visible within the user's own todo list (e.g., in edit history) but cannot be viewed by other users since this is a private todo application.

Key business rules enforced at the application layer:
- Display name must not be empty or contain only whitespace
- Display name can be changed at most once per 24-hour period (validated using last_display_name_change_at)
- Display name is private - no cross-user visibility

{@link todo_app_members} for the member actor identity.
{@link todo_app_edit_histories} for edit history tracking that references user display names.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link todo_app_members.id}. Unique 1:1 relationship - each member has exactly one profile.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's public display name visible in the todo application (e.g., in edit history). Cannot be empty or contain only whitespace. Subject to 24-hour change rate limiting.

plainFields.name: last_display_name_change_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent display name change. Used to enforce the rate limiting policy of maximum one change per 24-hour period. Nullable for newly created profiles before any display name change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Automatically set by the database when the profile is created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Automatically updated by the database on every profile modification.
